imports.n: Unwrought aluminium (HS 7601) from the United States to Malaysia: 0.536 Mt in 2024 (CEPII BACI), declared at 1,034 USD per tonne, 40% of the tonne-weighted median of the group (2,565); the 2024 average aluminium price is 2,419 USD per tonne (World Bank Pink Sheet), and the pair is declared at 43% of it. Material priced like scrap or alloy, or another cheaper product, declared under this code is a plausible cause; it is not established here.
